findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - Run the repository's full test suite after this repair.
The new `on_codex` condition makes doctor require Codex trust and print Codex notes for `tools = "both"` with Claude workers, but existing tests still expect the former behavior. `tests/test_codex_setup.py:223-235` expects doctor to succeed without trust; `tests/test_doctor_reports_only_used_worker_speed.py:26-36` expects no Codex Fast line; `tests/test_fix_the_owner_moved_this_repo_s_workers_from.py:109-114` expects no hook approval note; and `tests/test_fix_both_ui_skills.py:121-123` expects output to start with `Everything checks out`. Also, `tests/test_fix_reviews_always_run_on_codex_so_a_team_wi.py:67-81` still replaces the absent split setting, leaving both tools selected before removing Codex. These cases leave the full suite failing.
findings.title: Keep the existing test suite runnable with the new default

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A teammate runs doctor in a two-tool repo after Claude has signed out while Codex remains ready.
The repair enables the Codex checks, but `src/forge/doctor.py:367-368` still checks Claude sign-in only when `tools = "claude"`. New two-tool repos use Claude workers with the default `tools = "both"`, so doctor can report success even though the next Claude build cannot authenticate. The changed test at `tests/test_init_uses_signed_in_tools.py:57` always supplies a signed-in Claude and does not catch this remaining half of the reported issue.
Adds work: check the readiness of both used tools in doctor; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Check both tools' readiness with the new default

findings.body:

Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - Review the fix and its required checks before merging.
The supplied proof list remains `missing`, and the repair commits contain no mapping of the Done-when details to tests or pull-request checks. The required gate therefore still cannot verify the stated proof for initialization, review routing, cold reads, and the Claude-only case.

why: New client repos with both tools installed default to workers = split, so plain build work goes to Codex. Owner direction 18 Nov 2026: by default Claude builds everything, and Codex is used only for code reviews and cold reads.
